messages:
Maya: quick q — how should console surface SLO thresholds when tenant is on shared vs reserved capacity? want quota-aware routing hints + notify preds

Dom: propose adding `quota_affinity` to notify_policy schema. e.g. ```json
{"notify_policy":{"channels":["pager"],"quota_affinity":"prefer_reserved","sample_rate":0.1}}
```

Leo: hmm prefer_reserved needs fallback to best-effort. what about tenant-exhaustion signals? we should route to lower-cost model with degraded latency instead of spamming pages.

Sam: agree. also UX: show "expected noise" slider in rollout wizard with a simulated alert rate based on current traffic + thresholds.

Priya: telemetry needs to expose per-route token distribution + 95th latency projection. cc: @AlertBot can we surface a quick query?

AlertBot: deploy job started for notify-policy-service v2 at commit 9f2b3 — will post logs here.

Dom: backwards compat — schema must accept old `notify` boolean. plan: maintain adapter in API layer.

Maya: ok can we draft API change? Minimal fields: `notify_policy`, `quota_affinity`, `fallback_action`, `sampling`. We should add a "preview" endpoint to return simulated alert volume.

Leo: sample query for telemetry: `sum(rate(slo_violations[5m])) by (route,tenant)` — use this for preview.

Sam: UX nit — show examples: "would alert ~3/min" and link to tenant quota page.

Priya: +1. also add audit log entry when routing chooses fallback due to quota.

Dom: I'll mock up schema and small API patch. sending PR later today.

Maya: thanks. can someone take ownership of the rollout preview UI? Sam?

Sam: I can. filing a ticket.

Maya: awesome. tagging for followups: @Dom @Priya @Leo

(Reaction: :thumbsup:)
